units.text:
new file .changeset/client-secret-check.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+A build now fails with `secret_in_client_chunk` when a client chunk or asset holds a signing secret (`OGYGIA_SECRET`, or the build's own key) or a server module that signs region addresses.

new file .changeset/code-origins-every-import.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+`@ogygia/core`: in dev, a region's style module is imported only from the page's code origins, and a dropped download is asked for again only there, the same check an island's own code load uses (#981).

new file .changeset/devtools-feed-own-render.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+Devtools builds: the devtools stream takes server events only from the response's own side channel, not from one the page's markup carries.

new file .changeset/devtools-ingest-shape.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+On a devtools build, only well-formed server events from the page's devtools side channel enter the event stream, and `ingest()` (a saved trace, another realm) takes only well-formed events of either realm; anything else is left out.

new file .changeset/federation-code-origins.md
+---
+'@ogygia/federation': patch
+---
+
+`@ogygia/federation`: a shell's pages allow island code from every peer origin in `federate({ peers })`, replicas included, so peer islands still wake under core's code-origin check (#851).

new file .changeset/island-code-origins.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+`@ogygia/core`: island code loads only from the page's origin, the runtime's own, and the origins the server names on the runtime's script (a federation peer's); an `entry` or `src` anywhere else is refused with `island_code_refused`, and a region's `src` re-points only its own island's built file (#851).

new file .changeset/island-graph-any-entry-name.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+`@ogygia/core`: the island graph keeps every entry whatever its name; one named `__proto__` was lost on the way to the page (#994).

new file .changeset/mcp-args-schema.md
+---
+'@ogygia/cli': patch
+---
+
+`ogygia mcp` checks each tool's arguments against the tool's declared schema and says which one is wrong, instead of failing with "Internal error" or silently using a default.

new file .changeset/mcp-every-request.md
+---
+'@ogygia/cli': patch
+---
+
+`ogygia mcp` answers every request exactly once: a malformed one gets a JSON-RPC error instead of no answer (which left the client waiting).

new file .changeset/mcp-locked-profiler.md
+---
+'@ogygia/cli': patch
+---
+
+`ogygia_profile` says a locked profiler is locked (and asks for its secret, or says the key was rejected) instead of failing with "profiler did not return JSON".

new file .changeset/ogp-unpack-limit.md
+---
+'@ogygia/devtools': patch
+---
+
+The profiler stops unpacking an uploaded `.ogp` past 256 MB and refuses it with `devtools_profiler_upload_too_large` (413), instead of unpacking any size.

new file .changeset/parcel-reader-loop.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+`@ogygia/core`: the batch stream reader skips any number of malformed parcel openings in a loop, instead of running out of stack.

new file .changeset/peer-runtime-origin.md
+---
+'@ogygia/federation': patch
+---
+
+`@ogygia/federation`: a peer that serves its island code from its own assets origin (a CDN) wakes on the shell: the shell's page allows the origin of each peer fragment's own runtime, taken only from that peer's answer (#856).

new file .changeset/plugin-signing-domain.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+core: a plugin's `app.sign`, `app.verify` and `app.capability` sign in the plugin's own domain (its name, length-prefixed), so nothing a plugin signs checks as a region link or as another plugin's, dotted names included; plugin capability links minted before the upgrade are refused once and fall back like any refused hole

new file .changeset/profiler-key-web-crypto.md
+---
+'@ogygia/devtools': patch
+---
+
+The profiler checks its key and session in constant time on every host, with Web Crypto; on a host without `node:crypto` login works and no plain comparison is used.

new file .changeset/profiler-login-guard.md
+---
+'@ogygia/devtools': minor
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+devtools: in production the profiler accepts only a secret of at least 16 bytes; a shorter one keeps its pages closed and says so (`devtools_profiler_secret_short`)
+devtools: the profiler allows ten wrong keys per address in 15 minutes (the login form, `x-profiler-key` and `x-profile` share the count), then answers 429 until the window passes
+devtools: a profiler login is a random session id the server signs; it expires after 12 hours, logout ends it, and any change to it is refused (everyone logs in once again after the upgrade)
+devtools: the profiler's beacon flag cookie belongs to one login: it ends when that session expires or logs out

new file .changeset/rate-limit-shared-address.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+When the region render budget runs out for a private, loopback or link-local client address (a proxy's, shared by every visitor behind it), the server warns once with `rate_limit_shared_address`.

new file .changeset/region-answers-same-origin.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+A batch of holes is sent only to this origin's endpoint and writes nothing from an answer that ended on another origin, and `invalidateAll()` merges a refreshed page only when its fetch landed on this origin. Every string the runtime turns into DOM now goes through one module.

new file .changeset/region-capability.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+'@ogygia/machine': patch
+---
+
+core: region links are signed through `capability()`, naming the islands endpoint they are for and refusing a lifetime longer than the app ever mints; links stay identical between renders, and links signed before (pages cached before the upgrade) still work and are re-signed in the new form when renewed
+machine: `capability().mintUntil()` mints a token that expires at a given time, so tokens without a nonce stay identical across a window the caller picks

new file .changeset/region-request-order.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+core: a region request (a hole's GET, its renewal, each hole of a batch) walks one state machine, so rendering or charging the render budget before its capability verifies cannot happen

new file .changeset/remote-args-plain-data.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': minor
+---
+
+breaking: a remote function's argument sent from the browser must be plain data. The server now refuses an argument that holds an ogygia value (a region, a snippet, a function, a wired class instance, a store or a derived store) with a 400 and `remote_arg_not_data`, and runs nothing. Values the server sends to the browser are unchanged.

new file .changeset/restore-attr-reset.md
+---
+'@ogygia/reshape': patch
+---
+
+`@ogygia/reshape`: the restorer's attribute reset (`og-r`) never sets an `on*` or `srcdoc` attribute, or a `javascript:` / `vbscript:` URL (#851).

new file .changeset/restorer-close-safe.md
+---
+'@ogygia/reshape': patch
+---
+
+The restorer reshape inlines into a document the app's transform reshaped is now written the same safe way as every other inline script (no text in it can end the script element early).

new file .changeset/search-excerpt-one-pass.md
+---
+'@ogygia/content': patch
